entries.en: Back at the workshop, Cid receives a dressing down from Jessie for acting without due consultation and placing himself in mortal danger. The exasperated engineer subsequently notes the absence of Biggs and Wedge, who have apparently failed to return from their mission to Omega Control. Fearing that they may have encountered trouble, Cid resolves to look for them, and bids you join him at the airship landing in Gridania, where the Excelsior awaits.

L'ingénieur en chef des Forges de Garlond a alors décidé de prendre l'Entreprise Excelsior pour aller chercher vos deux camarades à la salle de contrôle d'Oméga. Rendez-vous à l'aérodrome de Gridania pour attendre qu'il passe vous prendre.

entries.en: Entering the control room, you are dismayed to find Biggs and Wedge sprawled on the floor, a slain fiend beside them. For a blessing, both are still alive, albeit in a bad way. The others soon join you, as does Omega via its communication system. It reveals that it was behind the attempt on the two engineers' lives, and threatens to kill innocent people unless you continue to participate in its experiment. Its objective: to study an anomaly known as heroes. Throughout history, it explains, otherwise unremarkable individuals have triumphed over vastly superior beings, just as you did in the Deltascape. Declaring itself “an enemy to all life upon this star,” Omega finally falls silent, leaving you to attend to your wounded friends.
entries.fr: À l'intérieur de la salle de contrôle, vous avez découvert Biggs et Wedge allongés par terre, à demi inconscients. Oméga est alors apparue pour vous révéler qu'elle était responsable de ce qui leur était arrivé, et qu'elle tuera d'autres gens innocents si vous refusez de participer à ses tests. Retournez à l'aérodrome de Gridania et parlez à Nero.

entries.en: Jessie is predictably shocked to hear the tidings from Carteneau. Though Biggs and Wedge will recover, Omega's threat looms large, and with little prospect of repairing its stasis system, Cid concludes that you have no choice but to obey its commands. Before long, you will be called to battle once more, and you fully intend to be ready.

Cid et tous vos camarades placent tous leurs espoirs en vous pour surmonter toutes les épreuves qui se dresseront entre vous et cette menace sans précédent !
